name: updateMedicalRecord
shortDescription: Handles the complex logic for updating a patient's medical record, including validation and audit logging.
description:
Overview

This function manages the update of a patient's medical record. It performs necessary validations, updates the MedicalRecord entity, and ensures that all modifications to Protected Health Information (PHI) are meticulously audit-logged for compliance.

Intended use

Called by the doctor-facing UI when a doctor modifies a patient's medical record. Parameters include the medicalRecordId and the fields to be updated (e.g., content, diagnosisCode).

Logic

  1. Retrieve the existing MedicalRecord using ctx.data.get with the provided medicalRecordId. If not found, return an error.
  2. Validate the incoming update data against business rules (e.g., doctor must be assigned to patient, data format).
  3. Update the MedicalRecord entity with the new data using ctx.data.update.
  4. Audit-log the modification of PHI using ctx.audit.log, detailing the changes made, the doctor who made them, and the patient's record affected.
  5. Return the updated MedicalRecord.

Entities

  • MedicalRecord
  • AuditLog
  • Patient
  • Doctor
